title: Category Card
description: The short "Browse By Category" tile that runs as a slider above the live blog landing and every category archive. A 100px band of photograph under a scrim, with the category name centred in uppercase heading type. The interaction is the inverse of the archive card's: this scrim *deepens* on hover — 33% to 75% — and an inset rule fades up inside the border, because the tile is small enough that lifting the scrim would lose the label. Measured from `#categories-slider .item` on 2026-08-20: 100px tall, rgba(55,71,80,0.33) resting and 0.75 on hover over 400ms, a 5px transparent border going to rgba(255,255,255,0.1) over 300ms with a 100ms delay, label Belleza 18px 600 uppercase. The live scrim is the site's one cool-grey; it is carried on neutral-900 here so the tile sits in the warm ramp with every other card. Live serves a placeholder JPEG for all nine tiles — the images are unset in the database, not chosen — so a real image per category is a content task, not a styling one. Scrim depth, border fade and reduced motion live in assets/styles/core-group.css. The label's link is stretched over the whole scrim so the tile is the target, as live's `.item > a` is — core/term-name only wraps the text itself. The tile carries a neutral-700 ground and a 100px min-height so it stands up when the term has no image — which is every category today: `sd_thumbnail` is registered for `accommodation-brand` only, so `sd/term-meta` returns null for `category` and core/image falls back to nothing at all. Without the ground the absolutely-positioned label collapses the card to zero height. Live has the same absence and papers over it with a grey placeholder JPEG; this is that placeholder without the asset.

styles.css: & { position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 100px; } & > * { margin-block: 0 !important; } & .category-card__media { margin: 0 !important; } & .category-card__media figure { margin: 0 !important; line-height: 0; } & .category-card__label { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: 0 !important; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--20); } & .category-card__label a { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--20); }
